section.p: The hours the boutique takes fittings. This is exactly what the booking page offers — change it here and the next customer sees the new times. A day can have two windows if you close for the afternoon, and if two brides can be in at the same hour, say so — the booking page will offer that hour twice.
Nothing set yet — the booking page has no times to offer. Add your first day above.

A holiday, a wedding, stocktaking. A closed date disappears from the booking page completely — no times, and no waitlist either, because there is nothing to queue for. Leave the second date empty to close a single day.
To shut only part of a day — you close at 14:00 for a wedding — fill in the two times as well. The day still appears, offering the hours you are open.
No closed days — the booking page offers every day above.
